selection: Ordinary English high-resolution nonfoil paper scans; UUID order frozen before measurements. First eight per material (or half of smaller cohorts) calibrate; remaining scans validate.
normalization: Fixed printed-scan geometry, never fitted to renderer assets. Per-card translation and uniform scale; 8ED also admits rotation/skew only with independent strip support. No per-card renderer changes.
